premises.text: Companies struggle with audience engagement and retention using traditional tools.
premises.evidence_span: every company is trying to build audience, engagement, and retention. They use a series of tools, if it's social media, ads, promotions, to name a few.

premises.text: Music has a profound effect on emotions and can increase spending and time spent in venues.
premises.evidence_span: research shows that using music online increases spending and increases the time in the venue.

premises.text: Using music online involves complex legal challenges.
premises.evidence_span: the unfortunate truth is that using music online is a legal nightmare.

premises.text: Feed FM provides a legal turnkey solution for adding music to digital products.
premises.evidence_span: we provide a legal turnkey way to add popular music to your website, app, or game.

premises.text: The Feed FM API and SDKs simplify music integration for developers.
premises.evidence_span: We've got a super simple API. And we have JavaScript, iOS, and Unity SDKs available.

premises.text: Music integration can significantly increase session times and engagement.
premises.evidence_span: we've seen results. In a recent blackjack game that was built, we ran an A-B test. Without music, session times were 11 minutes... With music, it was a totally different story. Session times grew to 51 minutes.

premises.text: The online e-commerce industry presents a massive market opportunity for Feed FM.
premises.evidence_span: The online e-commerce industry is a $370 billion business.

premises.text: Feed FM's self-service platform allows users to stream music for a low monthly fee.
premises.evidence_span: For the price of $25 per month, you can get popular music streaming on your website, app, or game.

value.text: Businesses can enhance customer engagement and retention through legal music integration.
value.evidence_span: we can focus on building an awesome product.

notes: No separate premises for the various tools used for engagement as they are bundled into one claim.
